les_mouvements_planetaires_de_cette_peri: The planetary movements during this period never express themselves in isolation. Together, they create a dynamic that influences your emotions, your way of acting, your relationships, and the opportunities that will present themselves to you.
votre_planete_dominante_donne_le_ton_pri: Your dominant planet sets the main tone for this period, while the other influences nuance your journey by emphasizing certain areas of your life. Some will favor action, while others will invite reflection, caution, or openness.
en_observant_ces_energies_dans_leur_ense: By observing these energies as a whole rather than separately, you will be able to make more informed decisions, recognize favorable periods, and better navigate challenges when they arise.
utilisez_ces_indications_comme_une_bouss: Use these indications as a compass rather than a certainty. Astrology highlights trends, but your choices remain at the heart of your evolution.
les_planetes_eclairent_les_tendances_de_: The planets illuminate the trends of your path, but they never make decisions for you. Welcome opportunities with discernment, take the time to observe what repeats, and choose actions that truly respect your rhythm. Every conscious decision can transform tension into learning and a possibility into true evolution.
les_influences_planetaires_de_cette_peri: The planetary influences of this period will be added here when generating your personalized horoscope.
